chapters.title: Chapter 1801: The Dark War (3)
paragraphs: During the Dark Era, when the Dark Creatures attacked, the universe was thrown into disarray, plunging many families and planets into darkness so thick and terrible that many never returned from it.
The death toll was on another level.

Warriors of varied backgrounds fought for the safety of this universe. Many died, but some survived. They went on to fight in several more battles, adding their names to the pages of other history books.
However, if all these people were here right now, witnessing the kind of destruction one person was causing, they probably would never recover from their past trauma.
Kent stood in the same place, still eating his apple, while all around him, beams filled with both flame and chaos energy rained down on the Dark Fiends.ree

It was as if the beams knew who to target and when to fire. The more the Dark Fiends came at him, the more intense the bombardment grew. It got to a point where the very planet started to tremble under the intense assault of the Eye of Chaos.
Fifty years in seclusion wasn’t for nothing.
On top of that, he now wielded the legacy of the Chaos Ascension King, which had transformed him from a mere warrior into a powerhouse who now stood against a Celestial with an army vast and endless.
Many armies would tremble at the sight of such a Dark Army.
Yet Kent was merely standing there, letting the Eye of Chaos do its work.

"It will do you no good if you don’t unleash your full strength now. Trust me, I’m still holding back, and the consequences of me going all out would be the end of you. So try and kill me before that time comes," Kent said with a small laugh.
He wasn’t threatened yet, and with his Eye of Chaos in action, he knew he wouldn’t be in any danger unless something changed.
CRACK
Suddenly, the void cracked, and a Celestial-level Dark Fiend rushed out, bearing its claw at Kent. It moved with blinding speed, hoping to take Kent by surprise.
However, before it could get close to him, Kent had already moved 4 km away, and in his place, a rune spider drawn from ice remained.
The Dark Fiend saw the rune, and it knew what came next. However, it had no time to retreat since the momentum it carried was so great that it kept moving forward.
BOOOM
The rune exploded, and webs fashioned from ice entangled the Dark Fiend, holding it in place.
Kent smirked, then he tapped into the Red Bone Chaos Devouring Art and started devouring the energy out of the still-living Dark Fiend.
Up in the air, the Dark Queen who came with the first wave of Dark Fiends became pale, feeling a very insidious energy seep into her body.
She immediately circulated her Celestial Qi to destroy this energy. However, before she could, she felt another energy, now with a corroding force, slowly worm its way into her head.
"Submit to me," Kent’s voice filled her head and traveled through her soul, turning her pale face even whiter.
Right about that time, Kent had finished draining the Dark Fiend, and using the energy, he decided to tap into his Nine Ascension Mind Demon class, the same one Kevin Sage wielded during the Ice Era.

The energy devoured from the Dark Fiend was channeled into Kent’s finger. Then, in one swift movement, he drew a rune in the air and pushed it with a tap of his finger, sending it into the Dark Queen’s forehead.
"NO," she exclaimed, sensing extreme danger.
However, Kent, who had been a master of runes back in the day, knew he wouldn’t fail with this, not when his soul was as vast as a universe.
"As I said, I am still holding back. But let’s have some fun."

The moment he said that, he formed a hand seal, and the mark that had appeared on the Dark Queen’s forehead lit up on the foreheads of over 500,000 Dark Fiends, ranging from the Demigod rank to the Celestial rank.
Kent felt his soul essence drain so much that he could tell only 5% remained.
’Damn, I guess I am still not strong enough for this spell,’ he said inwardly, then he smiled before smirking.
’Regardless, I can just devour and replenish it in mere minutes. But I can kill a few of them atleast.’
His gaze lifted, and then, in a sarcastic tone, he shouted, "Let’s have some fireworks."

He snapped his fingers, and all over the planet’s surface, thousands of explosions started to rock the battlefield. Dark Fiends of all sizes and ugliness started to explode, each having no idea how any of this was possible.

The explosions reached their cores, making them akin to core detonations. And while intentional core detonation would be severely devastating, being forced to detonate seemed to yield the same results.
The more explosions there were, the higher the death toll. In no time, the battlefield had turned into mayhem, with devastation littering everywhere.
"BASTARD!"
Somewhere deep inside the planet, a woman with pale white skin, ruby-red eyes, and runes of dark magic all over her barely covered voluptuous body cursed, jumping to her feet.

She had pale white hair and an aura of death and decay around her. This lady was the Dark Empress, the same entity who, had it not been for the Ruthless Bandit, would have brought the universe to its knees during the Dark Era.
She sat back on her throne, a dark aura of resentment oozing from her.

Seated not far from her were six Dark Queens, each with her own unique appearance. One was an ant in her demi-human form. Another was a spider, followed by a lioness, a phoenix, a dragon, and a Dark Elf.

"My lady, relax and let us handle this. I am sure this person has a strong backing, but we didn’t spend all these years planning and preparing to be humbled by a mere Demigod," the Spider Dark Queen said, earning collective nods from the other Dark Queens.
"I am sure the Jian Family is on their way here. Soon, they will arrive and put this bastard in his place. But before that, I volunteer to send some of my enforcers to hold him back."
The Dark Empress looked at the Spider Dark Queen and nodded.
"Go ahead. If worse comes to worst, we will abandon this place. We still have some preparations to make, so this kid and whoever is backing him cannot hinder us any further."

"As you command, my lady." The Spider Dark Queen dissolved into a mist of darkness and vanished from the room. Soon, over a million spider-like Dark Fiends filled the air, each speeding toward the battlefield.
Standing far away, Kent smirked.
"So you are planning to retreat, huh? I guess I will have to lower my guard a little to buy time for Tower to finish her awakening so she can seal the planet, preventing anyone from leaving."
He kept the Eye of Chaos active, but its intensity lessened, allowing more Dark Fiends to pass through and come at him.
Extending his hand, Kent summoned Gaap.
He allowed the Dark Fiends to close in on him, then, with deadly swings, he started cutting them down. Soon, he was swarmed, but with his current strength, he wasn’t even about to make a sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 1802: The Dark War (4)
paragraphs: It had already been over an hour since the battle between Kent and the Dark Empress began. Already, thousands of Dark Fiends had died, but Kent wasn’t unscathed either.
He had some cuts here and there, and most importantly, he seemed tired, his breath coming in ragged.
Well, at least that was the illusion he had put on. In truth, he wasn’t hurt or tired at all. If anything, he was much stronger now that death surrounded him everywhere.

He stopped devouring the energy from the dead bodies since that would tell the Dark Empress he was faking everything, prompting her to make a quick escape. Instead, he was devouring the death essence in the air, feeding everything to his Death Spirit.

Initially, Hades wanted to play hard to get. But after finding out Kent was the Chaos Ascension King, he became a good boy. For now, he was working well with him, fully aware that soon, he would become stronger than his past self.

"Master, can’t I heal your wounds? I feel like you being hurt is wrong in every way," Lady Kenzie, who couldn’t sit and watch Hades get all the attention, said into Kent’s ear while inside his soul sea.
Kent just smiled and replied,
"Your turn will come, sweet Kenzie. For now, let these bastards believe I am injured. It works in my favour after all."

Indeed, the closer they believed they were to killing him, the more time he could buy. Kent was hard to kill now, so death wasn’t something he feared. But he couldn’t allow the Dark Empress to escape, not when he had no sure way to stop her.
Even if he teleported to her side, he would have to kill five Dark Queens and some three others he could sense are far stronger than the Dark Queens.
Regardless of how he sees it, she would escape before he could cut her head off.
That was the only loophole in his plan now, so giving them the impression that he was close to death would make them believe they had the upper hand.
This was also the time to examine his combat abilities and see which ones worked in which situations.
Kent evaded a piercing attack from a spider-like dark fiend. Then, with a deadly swing, he severed the legs of another and, using the momentum, moved to a second one and cut it in half.
But that didn’t end there. He moved even deeper into the horde of monsters, slicing and dicing like he was a butcher.

Minutes soon passed, and before long, there were only ten minutes left until the awakening was over. However, just then, the void cracked, and from within, giant ships carrying powerful warriors started to emerge.

Kent moved back, evading a net attack from a spider-like Dark Fiend, and then focused his attention upward. There, standing at the bow of the leading ship, was a man clad in dark armor, wielding a large polearm.
He had the aura of a Peak Celestial Supreme, and from the look on his face, he was very angry.

He pointed his weapon at Kent, causing a powerful pressure to descend upon him. "Are you the one who killed Li Jian?" His words were filled with power as they crashed into Kent’s mind, forcing their way deep into his subconscious.
’Well, he is dangerous,’ Kent said inwardly as a smile appeared on his face.

"I came for the Dark Empress, and he tried to stand in my way, so I had to put him down. That said, is everyone in the Jian Family aware of your betrayal to the universe? Do they know their Patriarch has been shielding the Dark Empress all this years?"
At Kent’s response, some of the warriors standing behind Han Jian, the Patriarch of the Jian Family, shifted in their stance, clearly not expecting their leader to have done such a thing.
However, with the Eye of Chaos, Kent could tell that many others were already aware, as they clutched their weapons tightly, ready to fight him.
Han Jian frowned and asked, "What are you talking about, bastard? This place is home to an ally of my Jian Family. She is our asset and someone who has protected my family for years.

"Or are you saying insect cultivators are all Dark Creatures that have to be put down?" Han Jian sneered at the end, knowing his reply would surely dispel the doubt in the minds of many who had nearly begun to question him.
Kent smiled and shook his head. "Nice reply, Han Jian. But I think we both know she is the Dark Empress, and today, I will put her down.

"Now, while I would love to see you all come to your senses and retreat, I know it is impossible due to your blind loyalty. So here is what I am going to do. I will kill you all, and when I am done, I will visit every branch of the Jian Family and destroy their cultivation bases, making sure none of you can ever fight back again.
"But I won’t stop there. I will place a curse on the Jian bloodline, preventing future generations from ever attaining divinity. Consider this me showing mercy."
The sword in Kent’s hand trembled, and waves of blood slowly rose into the air, expanding and surging with such sharpness that even Han Jian felt his scalp go numb.
Kent had unleashed the [Blood Sea Annihilation] and merged his Sword Realm into it, causing it to take on the sharpness of countless swords.
His injured body remained the same, but a certain coldness had now filled his eyes and even seemed to affect the Eye of Chaos in the air.
In no time, the 20 km around him was filled with a blood-red sea. Everything caught within it was shredded and devoured.
"Now, bring your miserable lives for me to cut down."
The Blood Sea Annihilation surged, and at once, hundreds of thousands of swords formed. Then, with a mere gesture, the swords lung forward, bending space around them.
"KILL!"

Han Jian pointed his sword forward, and with his command, thousands of his warriors also surged forward. He watched as some managed to defend against the swords, but many also fell under the devastating assault of the Blood Sea Annihilation.
"Kinkade, kill this bastard," Han Jian said as he turned to a Celestial Monarch standing at the bow of another ship.
The man, with a head of blue hair, jumped from the bow of the ship, wearing an arrogant expression as he charged at Kent with his sword.
"How boring."
Kent, who had been waiting for the main threat to come at him, chuckled. Then he moved his sword, controlling the Blood Sea Annihilation to attack the bastard charging at him.
When they met, shockwaves spread everywhere, but Kinkade failed to break through the Blood Sea, causing Kent to grin.
’Looks like the Blood Sea Annihilation isn’t as simple as I expected.’
He smiled, then, tapping into his imagination, formed a 3 km-long curved sword entirely out of blood and swung it at Kinkade, who had little to no time to react.
The sword crashed into Kinkade’s defense, launching him high into the air.
Shock filled everyone’s faces as they watched a mere Demigod push back a Celestial. But before they could do anything, Kent extended his hand, and a large bow appeared in it.
Suddenly, as if time had slowed, he closed his eyes, and when he opened them, they turned golden. Then, behind him, a diagram with a large golden eye at its center appeared.
This was the [Omniscient Dao Eyes], and the bow was the [Timeless Dao Bow], the same weapon Kalimndra, the Omniscience Dao Archer, had used back during the Sun Era.
Kent tapped into the Omniscient Dao Eyes and then reached five seconds into the past. He formed an arrow and aimed...

chapters.title: Chapter 1803: The Dark War (5)
paragraphs: Kinkade, one of the Generals in the Jian Great Family, feared throughout the Western Supreme Galaxy for his ruthlessness, never expected that today he would be dying at the hands of a demigod whose attack came without him even sensing a hint.
It felt like time conspired against him, dying when he shouldn’t have.
When Patriarch Han Jian commanded him to kill Kent, he thought inwardly how much he was being looked down on by being asked to kill a mere demigod.
In his eyes, another demigod would be enough to do the work, or perhaps a god if they had to be sincere with themselves.
Obviously, he failed to register the carnage Kent had already caused in the form of thousands of mutilated bodies of Dark Fiends lying strewn across the battlefield.
So perhaps he didn’t see Kent as a danger. But then he moved, and what awaited him was a large sword formed from blood.
He managed to defend against it; however, as if he had been pulled through time, he sensed a danger coming from the distant past, arriving right when he clashed with the large blood sword.

Honestly, he didn’t see Kent fire an arrow. But at that moment, a deadly arrow formed from Evil Qi and Ice Qi stabbed him through the forehead, leaving his head frozen solid as life slipped out of his body.
Not even his Celestial Soul managed to detach from his body. The arrow killed both his body and soul. For a moment, he regretted not taking Kent seriously.
But he had long died, and five seconds into the future, Kent stood with a smirk on his face, everyone wondering where the arrow had gone.
"What just happened?" another General with the aura of a Celestial Monarch asked, looking at Kent holding perhaps the most elegant bow he had ever seen in his life.
"Maybe he missed," another person said.
"But how is that possible? He never even pointed the arrow at Kinkade, yet somehow he was killed." Five seconds was all it took for Kent to kill him and for them to register his death.
But that was enough to send chills down their spines, sweat breaking out across their foreheads.
Han Jian, who had given the command for Kinkade to attack, was left stunned, not expecting things to end this way. He had hoped that Kinkade would be able to kill the annoying brat grinning at them.
But now reality had finally set in, making him aware that the demigod brat smiling at them was a much bigger threat than anything or anyone they had faced before.
For a moment, he panicked. However, he recovered and realized he had more than enough manpower to take down this bug.
However, before he could make a move, which Kent knew would overwhelm him, he unleashed one of his superpowers... stalling.

"I have to ask, but why did you choose to side with the Dark Empress? I know you have already denied she is the Dark Empress, but humour me. What do you see in her that made you want to side with her?" Kent asked, knowing he wouldn’t be getting an answer.

But he didn’t mind. After all, he wasn’t stalling because he was an expert. He decided to stall because, long before the Jian Family forces arrived, he had already deployed runes aimed at messing with the mind.
Kevin Sage wasn’t known solely for his problem-solving abilities. He was someone proficient in the use of arcane runes.
Come to think of it, Kevin Sage might just be the most versatile of all Kent’s incarnations. He was one of the best alchemists to walk the face of the universe.
He was also a scholar with extensive knowledge across many fields.
He was also the legendary White Knight, who dominated many battlefields and even led the charge against the Ice Demons.
But while doing all that, he was also mastering arcane runes on the side. In fact, now that he was using them, Kent couldn’t help but see this side of him as the most dangerous.

After all, he could, on a whim, conjure runes with a mere thought. That kind of mastery over runic magic was unheard of. So while he was known as an alchemist, his other identities were those of legendary figures.
Today, he knew he had to buy time.
He was strong enough to face Celestials, but even a Primordial would become overwhelmed when hundreds of Celestials came at them at the same time.
So he wanted to buy himself some time and hopefully prevent the Dark Empress from escaping. If he unleashed his true power, he might be able to prevent himself from being overwhelmed.
But he might lose his only chance to catch the Dark Empress off guard.
So he activated the runes, and without Han Jian even being aware, his mind was being influenced as Kent spoke.

"In case you are not aware, then let me tell you what she and her people had done during the Dark Era. Back then, many thought the Ruthless Bandit was the most evil person in the universe. However, that thought changed when the Dark Creatures came.

They killed without any reservation, spreading chaos and mayhem everywhere. Many heroes rose to prevent them from swallowing all life. However, as you already know, many died, and many were permanently scarred.
All this happened simply because some people wanted the universe brought to its knees, but they didn’t have the balls to do it themselves.

Then here you are, standing with no shame, siding with the Empress of all Dark Creatures. Have you no shame, huh, Han Jian? Don’t you have a conscience to at least consider the pain these creatures have caused and turn your weapon on them?"
His words, as he knew, were falling on deaf ears. However, the influence of his Mind Runes was doing its work, causing Han Jian and his men to listen to him.
Kent checked the time till awakening... ’Five more minutes.’
He sighed and tapped into the narrative again. However, just when he was about to add more context, a spear came from nowhere, appearing before him in an instant.
Kent was too late to activate the Chaos Scale Shield, so he did the next best thing...
BOOM

His fist smashed into the spear, and at once, the flesh on his fist peeled off, revealing golden-blue bones. However, while he managed to defend against the spear, his body was pushed back several kilometers before he stabilized.
"SNAP OUT OF IT, LOSERS!" the Spider Dark Queen shouted, and at once, the hypnotic feeling that had overwhelmed Han Jian and his men cleared.

She extended her hand, and the spear flew back into it. The spear was made of bone, just like her hands. In her demi-human form, she had a skeletal body with spider-like appendages protruding from her back.
Wavy white hair fell down her back, and her ruby-like blue eyes shone with malice.
Han Jian, who sensed what had happened, gritted his teeth and was about to attack when the Spider Dark Queen raised her spear.
"Leave him to me. But be prepared to fight his reinforcements when they get here. I think he wanted to buy time, but I will kill him before they arrive."
She vanished from where she stood, and the next second, she was before Kent, her spear stabbing toward his chest. Kent smirked, then summoned a dagger, activating the Faceless Assassin Class.
Suddenly, darkness enveloped them as a fierce battle began inside the Faceless Shadow Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 1804: The Dark War (6)
paragraphs: Assassins are meant to stick to the shadows, stalking their prey, and just when they let their guard down, they attack, aiming to kill with a single decisive blow.
They are not meant to engage in one-on-one combat with their prey, especially not against one that is several levels above them.

However, Kent was doing just that. Hidden inside his Faceless Shadow Realm, he and the Spider Dark Queen were locked in what could be considered the most intense close-quarters battle of the past decade.
Every attack from the Spider Dark Queen was being countered so effortlessly that even she began to doubt her own strength and abilities.
In fact, she couldn’t understand how she still hadn’t cut down the annoying demigod brat who had come out of nowhere and started displaying power beyond their comprehension.
"Just die!"
Her spear carved a trail of purple light through the air, carrying dense Celestial Qi.

However, Kent’s dagger, coated in Divine Qi and Shadow Qi, blocked it. Then, with a twist of his hand, he twirled his other dagger. He lowered his head and, catching the dagger, attacked the Spider Dark Queen’s leg.
However, she managed to pull her body back.
This gave Kent the time to roll away, then he stabbed a dagger into the ground.
"Shadow Tendrils."
The ground cracked, and Shadow Qi spewed out. Then it all formed into tendrils and lunged at the Spider Dark Queen, who unleashed a wide sweep, severing them all.
Kent distanced himself and said with a smile,
"You know, I have never met a spider who is as fierce and crafty as you before." His words fell on deaf ears, and the next moment, the Spider Dark Queen lunged forward.

"Sad, really, to think such a fine creature as yourself had become corrupted by the Dark Empress." Kent jumped back, evading a deadly attack aimed at his chest. Then, kicking hard, he met the Spider Dark Queen’s spear.
He was blasted back, sending a shockwave across the battlefield.
Before he could even stabilize himself, he felt a presence appear overhead. The next second, a powerful spear descended toward him.
Kent dodged to the side, then turned to his left and smiled. "Looking down on me isn’t really something you should be doing, especially since you are running out of time."
’Two more minutes to go, then I can go all out and not care about anyone escaping,’ he said inwardly, spinning his daggers.

Kent locked gazes with the Spider Dark Queen, who, he could tell, was wondering just how a demigod could prove so hard to kill. Kent wasn’t someone she could kill easily, especially when he just stood there confidently, showing no fear of her.
This made her frown deeply, and then she decided to end the battle.
She lifted her spear into the air, and Celestial Qi mixed with Dark Qi started flowing into it.
’She is getting serious,’ Kent said inwardly.

Then he made his preparations as a massive spear formed in the air. A few seconds later, a spear nearly two hundred meters long shot forward, aimed at Kent, who smirked and summoned the Chaos Scale Shield.
BOOM
The spear struck the shield, and for a moment, it trembled. However, as if the spear wasn’t something to put much emphasis on, cracks formed across it, and it shattered.
But that wasn’t even the shocking part. Just as the spear shattered, Kent wrapped his energy around the fragments of the shattered Celestial Qi spear and formed a new one.
Then, with a decisive hurl, he threw the spear at the Spider Dark Queen, causing her expression to pale.
"What?"

She thrust her spear forward, meeting the giant one in a deadly collision. The impact blasted the Spider Dark Queen backward. However, before she could even wonder how any of this was possible, Kent became a dark mist and appeared behind her, stabbing with one of his daggers laced with Death Qi.
She managed to deflect it with her spear, but as a dual wielder, Kent went low and slashed her leg, drawing green blood.
"Arrggghh!"

She screamed, causing the Dark Fiends out there and the Jian Army to flinch. It had already been a couple of minutes since Kent and the Spider Dark Queen had clashed inside the Faceless Shadow Realm, but she still hadn’t put him down.
Naturally, that was shocking. But they had also seen how Kent had killed Kinkade and the thousands of Dark Fiends, their bodies littering the battlefield.
So while they most certainly had no understanding of how Kent was doing any of this, they knew he wasn’t an easy target to kill, not by a long shot.
"Just where did this monster come from?" some of the warriors started asking, each paying more attention to the carnage around them.

Because of the deadly explosions, most of the bodies had been reduced to piles of bones and flesh. However, they could still see thousands of Dark Fiends lying dead across the battlefield, telling them that before they arrived, a deadly battle had taken place.

More chillingly, the Eye of Chaos was still hovering in the sky, casting a terrifying atmosphere over everyone. Some of them had already lost their resolve to continue this fight, but deep down, they knew the main battle had yet to begin.
This left them at a loss for what to do.
Of course, they received their answer a minute and a half later when a figure covered in deadly cuts came flying out of the darkness.
Gasp
When the Jian warriors saw the grievous wounds covering the Spider Dark Queen, they all gasped, some taking trembling steps backward.
Kent walked out of the Shadow Realm smiling, his daggers still firmly held in his hands. More importantly, he looked at the countdown before his eyes.
[The Limitless Chaos Tower is awakening.]
Kent felt a powerful energy, so advanced and ancient, wash through his body, traveling through his Soul Sea, opening his Mind Sea, and even reaching his Soul Universe.
At once, he saw an elegant tower appear out of nowhere within his Soul Sea. The moment it touched down, Kent felt his soul growing stronger.
[Your Limitless Chaos Tower has awakened successfully]
The process lasted only a few seconds, but he felt so many changes within himself that he could tell he had become at least three times stronger...

Most importantly, he could sense his connection to everyone being restored. But to his utmost shock, he could also sense his connection to some people he had never met in this life, yet who had been friends, lovers, and allies in the past.
He couldn’t summon them, but he knew exactly where they were.
But if that wasn’t the most shocking part, Kent could sense, and even see, his Undead Legion all the way in the Undead Realm, something he couldn’t do before.
He could do the same for Indie, Miryssa, and Nyx, all the way in the Underworld.
’Well, I guess things have gotten out of hand then,’ he thought with a smile as he lifted his head.
"You know, why don’t we fight like madmen now?"
He raised his head and snapped his fingers, muttering just a single word.
"Seal."
The planet, which spanned fifty-five thousand light-years in diameter, was sealed, preventing anyone from leaving. If one looked at it from the outside, it was now covered by a massive purple dome.
Kent smiled, seeing he had nothing to worry about now, and then he summoned his legion and wives.
"Legion Call."

chapters.title: Chapter 1805: The Dark War (7)
paragraphs: "Legion Call."

This command was first spoken during the Primordial Era by the Primordial Chaos Dragon in the last moments of his life, when the Great War had entered its final phase, where victory and defeat hung in the balance.
This simple command reached into the distant future, summoning the 13 legions, each led by powerful warriors.
Today, Kent spoke those same words again, but compared to the Primordial Era, the results this time were disappointing.
Regardless, since he wasn’t summoning their future selves, Kent didn’t mind seeing these much weaker versions of the once glorious legions that brought the Void Beasts to their knee.

The first portal allowed the Eternal Wrath Legion to march onto the battlefield, now numbering over 45, with Gods and Supremes among them. There were even five Celestials, with the Ant King, the one he defeated in the Planet Killer Dungeon, being one of them.

It appeared the other dungeons he had unlocked were being cleared diligently by his legion in his absence. The weakest among them was an Immortal Lord, and she was Ankaara, the Ice Elemental, whom he planned to get revenge on soon.
Then, from the second portal, his Beast Legion, led by Yukiko, who is a Pseudo-Primordial, and a few others that had returned with him from the Star Realm.
The majority of them were, of course, the beasts he had tamed while inside the Forbidden Zone back when he ventured into the Star Realm.
But aside from them, one portal, which looked different from the first two, carried his Shadow Fiends, many of whom were already Gods and Supremes now that Kent had become a Demigod.
Their growth relies heavily on Kent’s growth. So he wasn’t so surprised to see some of them already Supreme.
Then, of course, his wives also came, led by Pandora, whose cultivation was suppressed by the Tower to the Pseudo-Primordial stage just so she could fight as well.
The moment they appeared, another portal opened, and Fiannarel, alongside the Seven Blood Warriors, formerly the Seven Tribe Leaders, now oozing the power of Celestials, also walked out.
In no time, Kent was surrounded by people he could count on.
He contemplated summoning the Undead Legion and the Night Riders, but he held himself back.
He could see they were in the middle of something equally important, so he chose to allow them to be. The battle wasn’t over yet, so the moment they became free, he would summon them over.
Of the people who came, Uncle Drake, or as he used to be called, the Flame Dragon King, also appeared eager to fight and put an end to the Dark Era for good this time.
"Little Brother, are you okay?" Fiannarel said, touching Kent’s forehead as if taking his temperature.
Kent just smiled and took her hand. "I am fine, Big Sister."

He turned toward his wives, who had already prepared to handle the battle first before the reunion. Seeing him holding someone else’s hand, the idea that they would be getting a new sister crossed their minds.
But then Kent spoke, and they all became extremely happy. "You all wanted to meet a sibling of mine. Well, here you go, this is my big sister, Fiannarel."
"Big Sister, these are my wives,"

Fiannarel’s eyes sparkled as she saw so many beautiful and powerful women, each one Kent’s wife. For a moment, she doubted he was telling the truth, but when she saw them smile and rush toward him, she became even happier.
Soon, the ladies surrounded her and started hugging her. She was happy to meet her baby brother’s wives, and they were happy to finally meet Kent’s sister.
Unfortunately for them, they were in the middle of a very dangerous battle, making it impossible to catch up properly. They would have to wait until they returned to the Tower.
Kent lifted his head and looked at the Spider Dark Queen, who wore an amused expression.
"If this is your reinforcement, then prepare to die, dragon."

As she said that, five Dark Queens appeared in the air beside her, and following them were millions of Dark Fiends. The atmosphere soon became shrouded in danger, casting an imposing shadow over the planet.
It appears the Dark Empress had sensed that she could no longer escape the planet, so she knew she had to go all out. Killing Kent was the only way out for her.
Unfortunately for her, Kent wasn’t done.
"You know, during the Dark Era, I planned to kill every last one of you, but I was fighting two battles at the same time, so I allowed you to live."
As he spoke, he formed a hand seal, and a purple runic circle appeared on the ground.
"The Dark Creatures came with an overwhelming number of warriors, ten times greater than what you have now. However, as the saying goes, the bigger they come, the harder they fall..."
He laughed, then snapped his fingers, manifesting a large, imposing coffin.

The moment the coffin appeared, a terrifying evil presence shrouded the planet, making everyone feel a sense of danger. Pandora, the Evil Queen, narrowed her eyes at the coffin, and for a moment, she trembled.
’He is about to summon another Grand Shaman, huh?’

Indeed, Kent was planning to summon another Grand Shaman after receiving the second Evil Key. He could have summoned him back in the Chaos Chasm, but because he wasn’t in his own universe, the process had to be delayed.
Now, there was nothing stopping him...

"Hear my call, oh mighty Grand Shaman Vorgun’Azhrael. ’Tis I, the Prince of Evil. Heed my summons and rise forth from thy eternal slumber, for your evil is needed and your mischief is being called upon. Rise, O great Vorgun’Azhrael."
The coffin trembled, releasing even more evil qi. Then, suddenly, through the thick, insidious atmosphere of evil, an unsettling cackle spread, causing even Kent to feel goosebumps.
"Kekekekekeke... Little Brother, you sure know when to awaken an old, ancient evil from a pleasant dream."
The lid of the coffin slid to the side, and from within, a figure rose to his feet in the most eerie way possible.
The second Grand Shaman appeared in his human form, but everyone gathered trembled when their gaze fell upon him.
He had pale ivory skin, a long, elegant face, a sharp jawline, high cheekbones, thin black lips, and a cold, emotionless expression.
His eyes were completely black, with silver pupils resembling dark, evil galaxies. He had waist-length silver-white hair, and he stood 7’4" tall with a lean, muscular physique.
But as if that wasn’t eerie enough, he wore an elegant layered robe made from spirit silk, funeral cloth, and abyssal fabric in shades of black, white, silver, and dark violet.
Millions of tiny soul runes moved across the robe like living creatures.
He turned to Kent and smiled. Kent also smiled back.
"Welcome to the Infinity Universe, Big Brother Vorgun."
In this vast universe, only Kent would call an Ancient Evil "Big Brother." However, as someone who had lived with all 24 Grand Shamans for years, he had no fear of him.
"Oh, little Ruthless Evil, you have no idea how happy I am to finally be awake."
His gaze swept across the Dark Fiends and the Jian Family, and for a moment, he licked his lips, causing them to tremble.
Vorgun was a Peak Celestial Supreme, but as an Ancient Evil, his mere presence commanded fear.
"And it appears you have prepared a fine feast for me as well."
Kent grinned and nodded.
"Feast on their souls, Big Brother. You have been asleep for far too long."
"In that case..."
He extended his hand, and Azgorath, the Soul Reaper Staff, appeared in his firm grip.

The majority of them were, of course, the beasts he had tamed while inside the Forbidden Zone back when he ventured into the Star Realm.
But aside from them, one portal, which looked different from the first two, carried his Shadow Fiends, many of whom were already Gods and Supremes now that Kent had become a Demigod.
Their growth relies heavily on Kent’s growth.
So he wasn’t so surprised to see some of them already Supreme.
Then, of course, his wives also came, led by Pandora, whose cultivation was suppressed by the Tower to the Pseudo-Primordial stage just so she could fight as well.
The moment they appeared, another portal opened, and Fiannarel, alongside the Seven Blood Warriors, formerly the Seven Tribe Leaders, now oozing the power of Celestials, also walked out.
In no time, Kent was surrounded by people he could count on.
He contemplated summoning the Undead Legion and the Night Riders, but he held himself back.
He could see they were in the middle of something equally important, so he chose to allow them to be.
The battle wasn’t over yet, so the moment they became free, he would summon them over.
Of the people who came, Uncle Drake, or as he used to be called, the Flame Dragon King, also appeared eager to fight and put an end to the Dark Era for good this time.
"Little Brother, are you okay?" Fiannarel said, touching Kent’s forehead as if taking his temperature.
Kent just smiled and took her hand.
"I am fine, Big Sister."
He turned toward his wives, who had already prepared to handle the battle first before the reunion.
Seeing him holding someone else’s hand, the idea that they would be getting a new sister crossed their minds.
But then Kent spoke, and they all became extremely happy.
"You all wanted to meet a sibling of mine.
Well, here you go, this is my big sister, Fiannarel."
"Big Sister, these are my wives,"
Fiannarel’s eyes sparkled as she saw so many beautiful and powerful women, each one Kent’s wife.
For a moment, she doubted he was telling the truth, but when she saw them smile and rush toward him, she became even happier.
Soon, the ladies surrounded her and started hugging her.
She was happy to meet her baby brother’s wives, and they were happy to finally meet Kent’s sister.
Unfortunately for them, they were in the middle of a very dangerous battle, making it impossible to catch up properly.
They would have to wait until they returned to the Tower.
Kent lifted his head and looked at the Spider Dark Queen, who wore an amused expression.
"If this is your reinforcement, then prepare to die, dragon."
As she said that, five Dark Queens appeared in the air beside her, and following them were millions of Dark Fiends.
The atmosphere soon became shrouded in danger, casting an imposing shadow over the planet.
It appears the Dark Empress had sensed that she could no longer escape the planet, so she knew she had to go all out.
Killing Kent was the only way out for her.
Unfortunately for her, Kent wasn’t done.
"You know, during the Dark Era, I planned to kill every last one of you, but I was fighting two battles at the same time, so I allowed you to live."
As he spoke, he formed a hand seal, and a purple runic circle appeared on the ground.
"The Dark Creatures came with an overwhelming number of warriors, ten times greater than what you have now.
However, as the saying goes, the bigger they come, the harder they fall..."
He laughed, then snapped his fingers, manifesting a large, imposing coffin.
The moment the coffin appeared, a terrifying evil presence shrouded the planet, making everyone feel a sense of danger.
Pandora, the Evil Queen, narrowed her eyes at the coffin, and for a moment, she trembled.
’He is about to summon another Grand Shaman, huh?’
Indeed, Kent was planning to summon another Grand Shaman after receiving the second Evil Key.
He could have summoned him back in the Chaos Chasm, but because he wasn’t in his own universe, the process had to be delayed.
Now, there was nothing stopping him...
"Hear my call, oh mighty Grand Shaman Vorgun’Azhrael. ’Tis I, the Prince of Evil.
Heed my summons and rise forth from thy eternal slumber, for your evil is needed and your mischief is being called upon.
Rise, O great Vorgun’Azhrael."
The coffin trembled, releasing even more evil qi.
Then, suddenly, through the thick, insidious atmosphere of evil, an unsettling cackle spread, causing even Kent to feel goosebumps.
"Kekekekekeke...
Little Brother, you sure know when to awaken an old, ancient evil from a pleasant dream."
The lid of the coffin slid to the side, and from within, a figure rose to his feet in the most eerie way possible.
The second Grand Shaman appeared in his human form, but everyone gathered trembled when their gaze fell upon him.
He had pale ivory skin, a long, elegant face, a sharp jawline, high cheekbones, thin black lips, and a cold, emotionless expression.
His eyes were completely black, with silver pupils resembling dark, evil galaxies.
He had waist-length silver-white hair, and he stood 7’4" tall with a lean, muscular physique.
But as if that wasn’t eerie enough, he wore an elegant layered robe made from spirit silk, funeral cloth, and abyssal fabric in shades of black, white, silver, and dark violet.
Millions of tiny soul runes moved across the robe like living creatures.
He turned to Kent and smiled.
Kent also smiled back.
"Welcome to the Infinity Universe, Big Brother Vorgun."
In this vast universe, only Kent would call an Ancient Evil "Big Brother." However, as someone who had lived with all 24 Grand Shamans for years, he had no fear of him.
"Oh, little Ruthless Evil, you have no idea how happy I am to finally be awake."
His gaze swept across the Dark Fiends and the Jian Family, and for a moment, he licked his lips, causing them to tremble.
Vorgun was a Peak Celestial Supreme, but as an Ancient Evil, his mere presence commanded fear.
"And it appears you have prepared a fine feast for me as well."
Kent grinned and nodded.
"Feast on their souls, Big Brother.
You have been asleep for far too long."
"In that case..."
He extended his hand, and Azgorath, the Soul Reaper Staff, appeared in his firm grip.

chapters.title: Chapter 1806: The Dark War (8)
paragraphs: Every Grand Shaman has their field of expertise. Of course, they each have an affinity for souls, since shamans are basically beings whose work has to do with souls.
But someone like Grand Shaman Malak is an expert in curses, while Vorgun specializes in manipulating souls.
In fact, he is the very definition of a Soul Reaper.

His power comes from harvesting souls and manipulating them to do his bidding. On a battlefield where death spreads as vast as an ocean, he would be like a merchant of souls, harvesting them and turning them into evil apparitions that would heed his command and wreak devastation.
Waking up Vorgun was the most logical decision Kent could make. After all, the battle ahead required someone with his particular set of skills.
He needed an army because, as it may be, his legion alone cannot handle this.
Kent turned and looked back at the Spider Dark Queen, who now wore a far more stunned and wary expression.
"As you can see, I came prepared. The question now is, do you have the power to stop me?"
His eyes narrowed. Then everyone behind him also turned their attention toward the sea of Dark Fiends, none of them showing even the slightest fear.
"If you think this is enough to stop us, then you are severely mistaken, dragon."
As the Spider Dark Queen spoke those words, she gestured forward, and tides of Dark Fiends surged toward Kent and his small army.
"As I said, you are ten times fewer than what we faced during the Dark Era, so today, you will fall, and I will make sure of that."
Kent closed his eyes for a few minutes. As he snapped them open, he activated the technique the Paragon had given him: the Omnipresent Universe Three Body Art.
A mist of purple energy surrounded him for a brief moment. When it cleared, his body split into three.
One took the form of his humanoid body, wielding Gaap, while two pairs of the Heaven Splitting Jade Void Wings appeared behind him. He stood 6’7" feet tall...

The second remained in his 7’6" feet tall demi-human form with another two pairs of Heaven Splitting Jade Void Wings. However, instead of a sword, his hands were covered by a pair of gauntlets, each ending in deadly talons.

The third transformed into a 1-kilometer-long dragon with metal wings. Kent covered his colossal dragon wings with three pairs of Heaven Splitting Jade Void Wings, which perfectly shifted to cover their immense span.
At once, his perception and mind split into three, allowing him to control all three bodies simultaneously.
His demi-human form turned to his legion.
"Pandora and Big Sister Fiannarel will lead you all to deal with those annoying humans. Kill every last one of them, for the more you kill, the greater your reward.
We do not take hostages, so kill them all.
That said, cut your coat according to your size."
Kent laughed.
"I will be close by, making sure none of you get overwhelmed. As for the rest of you..."
Kent turned to the Seven Blood Warriors and Grand Shaman Vorgun.
"We will handle the Dark Fiends, down to the very last one of them. Today, the only ones to remain alive will be us and not them."
"Very well."
Veylan Seren smiled, and then his body surged with Chaos Essence. As someone who practiced body tempering, his physical strength was evident from his mere presence.
He summoned a warhammer. Then, with a heavy leap, he descended into battle with chaos trailing behind him.
Jyoti Lata shook her head, but then she summoned an axe, and her lean, slender physique shifted into that of an imposing, muscular giant, almost like a barbarian.
She also charged into battle with catastrophic force.
The others joined as well, and before long, his wives and the legion, led by Pandora and Fiannarel, clashed with the Jian Family warriors.
Grand Shaman Vorgun also joined the battle, already taking advantage of the deaths being caused by the Blood Warriors.
In no time, only Kent remained in his three forms. However, his dragon form soon soared into the sky, and like the Calamity Dragon he was, he descended into battle with chaos in his wake.
His demi-human form also moved and clashed with the Spider Dark Queen, this time with the intent to kill her.
Before, he had merely been buying time for the Tower to awaken. However, now that he was certain none of them could escape, he wouldn’t hold back anymore.
"Tower, keep a close eye on everyone, especially my wives. The moment they are in danger, teleport them to safety."
"As you command, Master."
Kent sighed, then looked at the thousands of Dark Fiends charging toward him.
He smirked, then, with one hand, formed a seal.
"Eye of Chaos: Infinite Demon Eyes."
Suddenly, across the battlefield, thousands—perhaps tens of thousands—of crimson eyes snapped open, and from them, beams imbued with Chaos Qi began raining down upon the Dark Fiends.
But Kent didn’t stop there. He went on to unleash another technique.
"Blood Sea Annihilation."
The Blood Sea surged, and then he merged his Genesis Sword Realm with it, causing the already dangerous Blood Sea to surge with even more untamed power.
It transformed into countless deadly blades and began attacking everything in its path.
He looked at the carnage, but as the Chaos Dragon, he still felt like he hadn’t done enough.

So he went even further and activated the Shadow Realm. This time, instead of using it to cover the battlefield, he chose to call forth his shadow fiends that had been unlocked while inside the chaos chasm...
"Come out and show them the power of the Shadow Fiends."
From within his Shadow Realm, the Shadow Fiends that had been unlocked while he was away surged forth, clashing with the Dark Fiends.
There were thousands of them, each a force to be reckoned with.
Kent looked at the carnage and smiled.
"That’s more like it." He still has some more abilities, but he seems content with this much.
He looked up and saw that all the Dark Queens had been engaged.
Uncle Drake had already clashed with the Dark Dragon Queen, and from the look of things, it wouldn’t be long before she was defeated.
As for the Spider Dark Queen, she had already lost both arms, and as Kent turned toward his demi-human form, he watched him crush her head into a pulp.
To his shock, Parand alone had taken on the remaining four. Looking at how effortlessly she was handling them, he knew that even as a Celestial, she was still not someone he could defeat himself.
She is just too fast, even without her wings.
Turning to the other side, he saw that his wives and legion had already started overwhelming the Jian Family.
Pandora had used a technique to isolate the Celestials and Supremes, trapping them within a single domain where she, Fiannarel, Yukiko, and Vexthra clashed against them.

This strategy was a risky one, considering they were now locked in with over nine hundred terrifying Supremes and Celestials. However, because Yukiko and Pandora were both at the Pseudo-Primordial stage, it wouldn’t be long before they dealt with them.
Meanwhile, everyone else, ranging from Gods down to Immortals, was now at the mercy of his remaining wives and legion.
Despite the Dark fiends still numbering in millions, against only a few Celestials, a little over a dozen Supremes, and close to a hundred Demigods and Immortals, they stood no chance.
His Eternal Wrath Legion has five Celestials.
Basically, pitting a Celestial against a group of Gods was simply too shameless. But Vexthra, whose battle intelligence was on another level, had made the call, and Pandora made it happen.
Regardless, Kent could tell the battle was firmly on their side. The Jian Family would soon crumble.
However, the endless tide of Dark Fiends would still pose a huge problem.
’No need. I just have to locate the Dark Empress and kill her. That will solve everything.’
With his mission in mind, his Void Storm Domain expanded, and in no time, he located the Dark Empress...

chapters.title: Chapter 1807: The Dark War (9)
paragraphs: The battle had entered a chaotic state real quick, leaving thousands of dark fiends and Jian Great Family warriors dead, some losing their heads, while many had holes through their heads.
It was never really about who had the larger army, but who had the better one and whose team had the better tactics.

Kent’s side of the battle had both, and it was all thanks to Vexthra, the Goddess of Hatred and Resentment. She had a good head on her shoulders, so she made sure that even if one part of their battle wasn’t progressing well, the other parts would.

Unfortunately for the Jian Great Family, this was the Supreme Realm, not the Celestial Realm. Because of this, aside from a couple of Celestials, mostly the Generals, Vice Generals, and Han Jian himself, the rest were Supremes.
By pairing them against someone like Pandora and Yukiko, who are Pseudo-Primordial, they were basically powerless before them.

The odds were too stacked against them. But unlike what one would think, even Vexthra, who, while she had long since grown past the Universal God stage, still hadn’t become a Supreme, found going against Supremes wasn’t a problem at all.
She had grown much stronger than she was during the Inaya Supreme Ascension Ceremony. Her near-death encounter and failure to save her sisters from harm had forced her to become much stronger.
She even considered becoming a Supreme. However, with her Primordial Spirit still at the True God stage, she knew she had to wait a few more months, perhaps years, before taking that step.
But she wasn’t powerless against the Supremes anymore. If anything, as she unleashed one arrow after another, they started to run from her.
Her divinity, Hatred and Resentment, was perfect for battles like this.

Right now, every death carried resentment, and every warrior had hatred burning in their hearts. It was as if she had found her domain in the hatred and resentment burning in the heart of her enemies.
As she fought and killed, so did her domain grow stronger, covering more of the battlefield.

But away from her, the rest of her sisters were also doing an impeccable job. After learning that Kent had vanished into an unknown realm, they had all completed their missions much more quickly and rushed back.
While they couldn’t do anything to look for him, they knew they had to be there when he returned. Unfortunately, he returned bringing war with him.

But they weren’t shaken, not even by a long shot. They had powerful sisters protecting them, so someone like Unity, who was only an Immortal Lord, had the confidence to shoot arrows at demigods and gods.
She never missed, not by a long shot.
"You know, this brings back old memories," a whip flashed across the battlefield, followed by bodies igniting in flames, some being severed in half.
Meiko looked at Unity, whom she had chosen as her little sister after spending time with Kent’s wives. Well, she was one of his wives, just that she hadn’t officially joined the harem.
That would soon change, though...
But she and Unity were now best friends.
"Big Sister Meiko, I feel like this isn’t the best time to go down memory lane," Unity said, putting an arrow through the eyes of a demigod and another through their chest.
Meiko laughed and unleashed another whip, spreading chaos everywhere.
"This is the best time, Unity. I had so much fun during the Flame Wars. To think that only a few months after I was reborn, I would find myself in yet another battle of this magnitude."
She laughed, and more targets continued to die.
Unity hadn’t known her for long, but she could tell Meiko was just like Kaizo. She was chaotic and loved battles.

’Speaking of Kaizo, I can imagine how pissed he would become when he returns and learns we fought in the Dark War Part Two in his absence,’ Unity laughed inwardly, already planning to tease the undead brute who loved nothing more than battles and chaos.
Across the battlefield, there was chaos everywhere. However, on one side, Neomi, the mother of the Killers, seemed to have lost herself in the slaughter.
This was a battle to kill, not accept surrender, so she had taken on her Shara form, wielding two short swords.
However, while one would see her as a mere Immortal Lord and try to take advantage of her, demigods were literally running from her.
It was mind-blowing to see demigods run from an Immortal. But they were, and it simply was because of the aura around her.
A few hundred meters away from her, Fiannarel, who had just severed the head of a Supreme, sensed a familiar aura coming from one side of the battlefield.
Turning toward the direction, her gaze landed on Neomi, who had one sword stabbed through the chest of a demigod and the other meeting the spear of an Immortal Lord.
"It can’t actually be her, right?" she muttered, watching as Neomi killed some more.

Every time she killed, with Fiannarel’s advanced sight and vast soul, she could sense that the souls of the dead became agitated, eager to run from her. But death wasn’t claiming them, so they had no choice but to turn into killing intent and merge with her.
It is mind-blowing to see death tremble before her, scared to take her kill from her.
Fiannarel continued watching for five more good minutes before she finally accepted that the person she knew was indeed Neomi.
During the Sun Era, she had the privilege of exploring a unique ruin from the Flame Era. While there, she came into contact with a broken spear.
She was curious as to why a broken spear could still look clean even after several eras had passed. However, when she touched it, she saw it.
Imbued into the broken spear using Killing Intent were the final moments of the Flame Demon to whom the spear belonged. She saw who killed him.
That sight and feeling sent her into a state of enlightenment, one that, when she came out of it, allowed her to finally comprehend Bow Intent.

But despite her achievement, she never forgot the feeling and the presence she had witnessed. Today, she sensed that presence again, and now she could tell Neomi was the redheaded demoness who had beheaded that Flame Demon and severed his spear.
"Just where did Little Brother find such a terrifying woman?" Her gaze swept over the battlefield, spotting Kent in all three forms.

One had long since killed the Spider Dark Queen and was now tearing through the flesh and bones of the dark fiends. Another was now a dragon, moving with such speed that wherever he passed, chaos and mayhem were left in his wake.
The last one had just arrived before a building and kicked in the door, revealing a hall lined with powerful Dark Fiends, each possessing the aura of a Peak Celestial.
Before Kent could make a move against them, Han appeared beside him, standing on a large sword with his hands clasped behind his back.
"Why don’t I handle them, Big Brother?" he said, gliding down with a smile on his face. He had been in seclusion long before Baldy and Inaya ventured into the Calamity Zone.
It appeared that, sensing there was a battle, he had come out to fight...
Kent looked at him and smiled as well. "But of course, Han. Suit yourself."
Han jumped down from his sword, and it flew into his waiting grip. "Well then, let’s see what you guys are made of."
Suddenly, the scene around them changed, sending everyone into a world of mortals. Kent sensed all the energy in the air drain away, leaving every Celestial feeling like a mortal.
His brow furrowed.

"Big Sister Meiko, I feel like this isn’t the best time to go down memory lane," Unity said, putting an arrow through the eyes of a demigod and another through their chest.
Meiko laughed and unleashed another whip, spreading chaos everywhere.
"This is the best time, Unity.
I had so much fun during the Flame Wars.
To think that only a few months after I was reborn, I would find myself in yet another battle of this magnitude."
She laughed, and more targets continued to die.
Unity hadn’t known her for long, but she could tell Meiko was just like Kaizo.
She was chaotic and loved battles.

’Speaking of Kaizo, I can imagine how pissed he would become when he returns and learns we fought in the Dark War Part Two in his absence,’ Unity laughed inwardly, already planning to tease the undead brute who loved nothing more than battles and chaos.
Across the battlefield, there was chaos everywhere.
However, on one side, Neomi, the mother of the Killers, seemed to have lost herself in the slaughter.
This was a battle to kill, not accept surrender, so she had taken on her Shara form, wielding two short swords.
However, while one would see her as a mere Immortal Lord and try to take advantage of her, demigods were literally running from her.
It was mind-blowing to see demigods run from an Immortal.
But they were, and it simply was because of the aura around her.
A few hundred meters away from her, Fiannarel, who had just severed the head of a Supreme, sensed a familiar aura coming from one side of the battlefield.
Turning toward the direction, her gaze landed on Neomi, who had one sword stabbed through the chest of a demigod and the other meeting the spear of an Immortal Lord.
"It can’t actually be her, right?" she muttered, watching as Neomi killed some more.
Every time she killed, with Fiannarel’s advanced sight and vast soul, she could sense that the souls of the dead became agitated, eager to run from her.
But death wasn’t claiming them, so they had no choice but to turn into killing intent and merge with her.
It is mind-blowing to see death tremble before her, scared to take her kill from her.
Fiannarel continued watching for five more good minutes before she finally accepted that the person she knew was indeed Neomi.
During the Sun Era, she had the privilege of exploring a unique ruin from the Flame Era.
While there, she came into contact with a broken spear.
She was curious as to why a broken spear could still look clean even after several eras had passed.
However, when she touched it, she saw it.
Imbued into the broken spear using Killing Intent were the final moments of the Flame Demon to whom the spear belonged.
She saw who killed him.
That sight and feeling sent her into a state of enlightenment, one that, when she came out of it, allowed her to finally comprehend Bow Intent.
But despite her achievement, she never forgot the feeling and the presence she had witnessed.
Today, she sensed that presence again, and now she could tell Neomi was the redheaded demoness who had beheaded that Flame Demon and severed his spear.
"Just where did Little Brother find such a terrifying woman?" Her gaze swept over the battlefield, spotting Kent in all three forms.
One had long since killed the Spider Dark Queen and was now tearing through the flesh and bones of the dark fiends.
Another was now a dragon, moving with such speed that wherever he passed, chaos and mayhem were left in his wake.
The last one had just arrived before a building and kicked in the door, revealing a hall lined with powerful Dark Fiends, each possessing the aura of a Peak Celestial.
Before Kent could make a move against them, Han appeared beside him, standing on a large sword with his hands clasped behind his back.
"Why don’t I handle them, Big Brother?" he said, gliding down with a smile on his face.
He had been in seclusion long before Baldy and Inaya ventured into the Calamity Zone.
It appeared that, sensing there was a battle, he had come out to fight...
Kent looked at him and smiled as well.
"But of course, Han.
Suit yourself."
Han jumped down from his sword, and it flew into his waiting grip.
"Well then, let’s see what you guys are made of."
Suddenly, the scene around them changed, sending everyone into a world of mortals.
Kent sensed all the energy in the air drain away, leaving every Celestial feeling like a mortal.
His brow furrowed.

chapters.title: Chapter 1808: The Dark War (10)
paragraphs: Before his final battle with the Abyss King during the Divine Era, Jest gave his seven Eternal Sword Intents, whom he had turned into seven capable swordsmen, a mission.
They were to create and master a single sword technique from the basic stage all the way to the next realm—the realm above the Sword Celestial stage.
A couple of years ago, he found out that one of them had created the Starfall Sword Technique, one of the most powerful sword techniques in the universe.
Today, he was witnessing Han’s technique in person.

The moment he activated it, every single person he had chosen, including himself, was sent into a domain, or perhaps a realm of mortals, where, aside from pure sword or weapon mastery, none of them could use their energy.
So basically, the battle that was about to happen would be fought between mortals, where a stab to the heart would kill.

Han was a mortal, and the twenty-four Celestials he had trapped inside the domain with him were also mortals now. It is humbling to see one return to where it all started, from mortal to immortal, and then to Celestial.
To master this technique, it was why Han had spent many years wandering around, living mostly among mortals.
If Kent had paid attention to Earth’s history, specially history of ancient Japan, he would have found a samurai with an uncanny resemblance to Han.

"What have you done to us?" one of the Celestial-grade Dark Fiends trapped inside the Eternal Karmic Sword Domain asked, pointing his spear, which now seemed much heavier and impractical to wield in a battle fought on a mortal level.

Han smiled, tied his hair into a ponytail, and answered, "This is the Eternal Karmic Sword Domain, buddy. In here, we fight like mortals and bleed like mortals. Unless you manage to kill me, then forget about ever leaving this place."

He scanned the faces of his twenty-four opponents and added, "Well, every hour, we climb one realm. So an hour from now, if by some miracle you all are still alive, then we will transcend to the Medium World, each of us wielding the powers of a Spirit Core Formation cultivator."
He laughed, amused by the expressions on their faces. "That is, if you all manage to last that long against me."
Han had been alive for over ten eras, every single one spent mastering his sword. It would be a miracle if these people lasted half an hour against him, especially now that they were mortals.
"Well then, come at me. I don’t have all day."
And with that, a great battle was underway.
Kent only remained inside the Eternal Karmic Sword Domain for a couple of seconds, but he knew with absolute certainty that Han would kill them all in no time.
Even as a mortal, Han had the aura of a true swordsman, someone who had mastered the sword through constant practice and deadly battles.
Of course, Kent didn’t focus much on it since he had already sensed the Dark Empress’s gaze on him.
Moving across the hall, he appeared inside another room where three people stood blocking his path.

"Isn’t it tiring for you, hiding behind minions when you could come at me like a worthy opponent? I mean, what makes you the almighty Dark Empress when all I’ve seen is you hiding behind your minions?
Can’t you fight to save your own skin?"
"Human, what do you want?" From behind the three Dark Fiends, the Dark Empress asked, causing Kent to grin.
"What do I want? Surely you already know what I’m here for."
"Can’t we come to an agreement? Surely, you would benefit from forming an alliance with me. I can even swear not to attack your universe if that is what you want."
Kent laughed, amused by the Dark Empress’s attempt at disguised diplomacy. She clearly wanted to leave here alive today, and Kent could sense the desperation in her tone.
But he sensed deceit, too.
Kent could tell that even if she were to swear a blood oath today, she could turn her back tomorrow and attack him and the universe. This was simply possible through body sharing.
She could sacrifice a part of her soul, place it into the Dark Queens, and use them to attack the universe while her main body stayed hidden somewhere.
So while swearing she wouldn’t attack the universe, she could indirectly do so with minimal repercussions.
This meant killing her here and now was a must. Unfortunately for her, Kent planned to kill her.
Paragon had done him a solid by allowing him to locate her main body. So no matter what, he would kill her, finally bringing an end to the Dark Era and the Dark Empress.
"Unfortunately, I cannot accept your plea, Dark Empress. You have to die today, so if you could kindly do that by detonating your soul, I would be more than happy."
"Human, do you think killing me today would be your victory? Even if I die today, none of you will be leaving this planet alive, so you’d better think this through before you regret it in the end."
Kent said nothing. Instead, he started circulating his energy, causing the three Dark Fiends blocking his path to do the same.

It appeared Kent had no plans to compromise with their Empress, so the next logical move was to kill him and put an end to whatever plans he had, thinking he alone could defeat three Pseudo-Primordials and get to the Dark Empress.
For a moment, the air hung in a tense vacuum, with no sound whatsoever coming in or out. However, that stalemate was soon broken by a crack and an explosion, bringing the entire building down.

Four people shot into the air, and the next moment, a collision of power so fast and overwhelming erupted from their bodies. Kent met the saber of one of the Dark Fiends, whose body was made of metal.
The moment they clashed, Kent sensed the force and strength behind the Dark Fiend’s blow. However, instead of becoming wary, he smiled and adjusted his own strength.
’Looks like this battle will take more than brute strength.’ Good thing he possessed a vast array of abilities and classes he could employ.
Aside from that, his bloodline was now stronger than ever, and more importantly, he had awakened so many Blood Runes that he couldn’t even fathom how any of it was possible.

He could unleash a large number of them without feeling a thing. However, Kent wasn’t there yet. In fact, he was still far from that point, since he believed he could do much more than he had shown so far.

He knew he had to start slow and work his way up the ladder. This was so that he could at least get used to his own strength and not hurt anyone during the sword competition he planned on entering about a year from now.

So he tapped into the Genesis Swordsman Class, and with just five percent of his Extreme-grade Divine Sword Energy, he began a focused and well-executed close-quarters battle, one where his past as Lord Genesis was being channeled in its entirety.
He parried one attack and dodged a second, only for a third to come from what the attacker believed was his blind spot. However, Kent—or more importantly, Lord Genesis—had no blind spots.
He saw the attack coming and, tapping into the 1.6 million possible close-combat moves he knew, found three ways to defend against it.
And he did, with a mere flick of his finger.
Five seconds later, the attacks unfolded exactly as he had foreseen. But this time, he counterattacked, aiming to take one of them off the board.

chapters.title: Chapter 1809: The Dark War (11)
paragraphs: Kent underestimated the power of a Pseudo-Primordial, much less three of them.
He knew his current power was enough to kill Celestials.

He had already killed a few, but he was aware that not all Celestials were the same. He could not, in all honesty, face off against any of his Blood Warriors and win, just as he could not easily win against Vexthra, who wasn’t even a Supreme.
There are levels of strength, talent, and experience, and he was perfectly aware of that.
However, here lay the case that, at merely the Demigod stage, he had already gained the strength and power to face off against Celestials and shrug off the attacks of Supremes.
Gods were even bugs before him, though not all of them, especially not someone like Miryssa or some members of his Eternal Wrath Legion.
He had the power, the talent, the cultivation techniques, the martial techniques, the weapons, and most importantly, the bloodline and bloodline innate talents to back his strength.
He had it all, and compared to these three Dark Fiends, he was far superior. So, having some arrogance, simply from being an overachiever, was certainly within his bragging rights.
However, the idea of looking down on them and actually killing them was two different things, and Kent had finally realized it.

With his Omniscient Dao Eyes, he was able to see five seconds into the future, making sure he attacked where they displayed openings. However, when he did, he found himself going against a Pseudo-Primordial’s reaction speed.
They were fast and deadly, and Kent, who had only exchanged blows with them for two minutes, had already sustained a cut across his chest.
Though looking at it, he smiled, and then it healed.
Lady Kenzie, who had already been bored since she could not heal Kent, now found herself healing three of his bodies, making her very happy.
Hades, on the other hand, was taking a nap while torrents of Death Essence flowed into his core. He was not bothered by the battle outside, not when he had no plans to intervene unless called upon.
He liked to be wanted, and Kent, who had already realised that, planned not to need his help. But can he really keep him at bay?
After two minutes of close combat, he saw he had underestimated his opponents, so he reached into his cores, and three more energies surged, merging with the Divine Sword Energy.
On the outside, Kent’s body surged with Chaos Qi, Evil Qi, and Abyssal Qi.
At once, he went from a mere Demigod to a dangerous Demigod, and when he moved, flame runes surged into his legs, carrying him in a blur.
The second phase of the clash began just two minutes into the battle, and this time around, Kent was not taking his opponents lightly.

The Dark Empress stood back, staring at the carnage all around her with a look of anger and revenge. She was not done with her preparations before attacking the universe, so being ambushed before that, she clearly did not want it.
But she was under attack now, and watching Kent and his allies lay waste to her army of Dark Fiends, she hated it.
Suddenly, her expression narrowed. Then she turned to her left, her gaze landing on Lani, who was clad in an assassin’s wear, with five tendrils of fabric billowing behind her like capes.
In her grip was a scythe oozing with extremely dense Death Qi and killing intent.
"Impossible," the Dark Empress muttered, watching Lani cleave through her Dark Fiends as if they were grass, her innate laughter spreading across the vast battlefield.
"H-How is she here?" she muttered, unable to contain her shock. The more she looked, the more memories of her final preparations before their first invasion of this universe came back to her.
Before coming, they had received the names of people to look out for from the Primal Temple. On that list, Ruthless Bandit was the first, followed by Kael Duskbane, Captain of the Night Riders.

Many names were on that list, and one of them was the Silent Shadow, or as many knew her, the Joker. They said she was raised by a team of assassins into a deadly weapon that had claimed the lives of both the good and the bad.

However, along the way, she had a change of heart, so she killed the people who raised her, and since then, she has chosen to do good. Her chance to atone for her past transgressions arrived when the Dark Creatures came.
She killed a lot of them, so much so that even the Dark Empress was tempted to personally come after her, for she was that deadly. She never forgot that laughter, even long after the Joker had died.
Today, she heard it again, and the same sight she saw the last time was repeating itself, only this time, Lani was an Immortal Lord.
This meant she could be killed, and since the Dark Empress had already been caught off guard, killing some of the brat’s allies who her three guards were now locked in battle with would feel good.
Surely, that would make her very happy.
She tried to move, but found herself trapped in a domain. Kent knew he could not allow her to move, so he asked the new overpowered tower to keep her at bay.
Regardless, she didn’t panic.
Across the battlefield, hidden somewhere in a cave, were five hundred thousand Supreme-level Dark Fiends, each clad in dark armor made of metal and wielding deadly broadswords.

These were her secret army, the ones she planned to use to conquer the universe once she was done awakening their bloodlines. Unfortunately, she had to use them now while they were not at their strongest.

If she had had a few more hundred years, she would have perfected them, making them all powerhouses that couldn’t be shrugged off, unlike some of the Dark Fiends, who were a bit disappointing, if Kent and his allies had to be honest with themselves.
But despite wielding only half their power, they were still a force to be reckoned with.
A command entered their heads, and then five hundred of them moved, and before Kent or anyone else could tell how, Lani found herself surrounded.
It happened so fast. Before any of them could reach her, she was surrounded, and then they attacked, every last one of them.
Kent only caught their sudden appearance, but he knew there was no miracle that could save Lani unless, of course, she had Death on her side.

Just before the attacks could land on her body, a figure clad in dark robes wearing a drowsy expression appeared beside Lani, and with a wave of his hand, the five hundred Dark Fiends were blasted back.
"I am not happy being called into battle," Hades complained, looking at Lani, who wore a shocked and panicked expression.
It appeared Vexthra had made a great plan, but the Dark Empress didn’t mess around either. She also had her backup plan.
"Uhm, thank you for saving me, Senior," Lani, who hadn’t met Hades yet, said, thanking him. Seeing her sincere expression, he didn’t let his drowsiness linger.
His gaze drifted across the millions of names tattooed on Lani’s skin, and he sighed.
"You have a lot to atone for, young lady. Good thing you have an affinity for death, so I will help you clean more of those tattoos."
He turned into a mist and then augmented Lani and her weapon. At once, Lani’s body surged with so much power that the dark fiends panicked.
She stood her ground and clashed with them, this time augmented by death, which made her immune to it.
The Dark Empress’s eyes narrowed, but she didn’t linger on it for long since she had yet again spotted another familiar face...
